Upcoming Update Question for the Community
notes.notes:
ːdialogbubbleːHey MFL2 Steam Community!

We’re gearing up for our next update and the release of new teams, and we’d love to get your feedback on an ideaːwinter2019happybulbː we’re considering.

In the past, we’ve only released teams with completed customization and finalized playbooks. However, we now have all 32 teams with rosters and ratings readyːcrateː — though about 12 of them still need their personalizationːcool_seagullː and playbooksːSocialPolicyː.

ːdialogbubbleːSo here’s the question: Would you be interested in seeing all 32 teams in the game now, even if some are still a work in progress? We’d make it clear which teams are unfinished, and this way, you could jump into a full 17-game season mode with all conferences and divisions in place. Plus, we’d love to hear your feedback on your gameplay experience! As time goes on, we’ll add the final touches to those remaining teams.

We’re here to listen! If you’d rather wait for each team to have finalized ːGemsːcustomizationːcool_seagullː and playbooksːSocialPolicyː, just let us know, and we’ll stick with the original release planːdragonsealː.

One more update: Our October release is coming on Friday, November 1st, 2024! Expect to see:

      a new character (our work-in-progress ːknightsarmourːrobotːpaperdeathː);
      4 new teams;
      part of the RPO feature, including Play Action plays.


Looking forward to hearing your thoughts and seeing you in the game! Thanks again to all of you for being part of the MFL2 Early Access journey.


Thank you,
DDE Team

[Update] June 10, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've added Steam Deck to our list of target platforms, and this means that from now on, we will be dedicating resources to ensure you have an enjoyable gaming experience on it. Today's patch should improve the game's performance on the Steam Deck and here is list of all changes:

 Created a separate "Steam Deck" graphics profile;
 Improved memory consumption;
 Support on-screen keyboard.


Please be aware that we are testing everything on the "vanilla" Steam OS. 
If you have a different setup and encounter issues, please let us know in the dedicated thread here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1657320/discussions/2/4330853251139980766/
